hooks.command: sh -c 'd="$PWD"; while [ "$d" != / ] && [ ! -f "$d/.claude/hooks/predelivery.py" ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; f="$d/.claude/hooks/predelivery.py"; [ -f "$f" ] || f="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/hooks/predelivery.py"; if [ ! -f "$f" ] || ! command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf "%s" "{\"systemMessage\":\"pre-delivery check did not run — no .claude/hooks/predelivery.py at or above $PWD and none under ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}, or python3 unavailable; enforcement is off for this write (master §9.5)\"}"; exit 0; fi; python3 "$f" --hook'
